agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Four Pokémon fainted. Lildozer and Croakatoa dealt priority damage first; Bushtank's 1-HP active sack protected Bugatti's entry; Bugatti's Rollout protected Birdlaw's entry.
Eelektrik critically KOed Croakatoa after one Vacuum Wave, but the unchanged policy recovered through Bushtank and retained both Ohmnomnom and Birdlaw.
This win fell from 27 to 24 decisions and improved from one to two survivors without a behavior change.

correct_choices: The only voluntary switch was Ohmnomnom to Lildozer, which then acted for three turns.
Every later switch followed an authoritative faint boundary.
No replacement switched back out without acting.
Bushtank finished Eelektrik before its planned active sack.
Bugatti stayed against Dustox and Birdlaw won after a damage-free forced entry.
agent_review.next_test: Run unchanged v15 Clone 3 from the identical opening; require another reviewed terminal win and no switch-in no-action sacrifice.
